quote: The extreme code summarization task asks a model to predict the name of a method given its body. Summarization models could help programmers interpret poorly documented code.

...The extreme code summarization task asks a model to predict the name of a method given its body ... We create a JavaScript summarization dataset using the 81,487 labeled methods in the CodeSearchNet dataset. The name is masked in the method declaration...
We address clone detection, type inference, and summarization.
we evaluate model predictions by precision, recall and F1 scores over the set of method name tokens.
